cases.disposition_reason: TablePro opens Connections at 120×40 in truecolor with reduced motion. A click on Development, then Connect, finishes on Query 1 once Connected to Development is shown and Loading schema has left the screen. Ctrl+O, products, Enter opens the editable public › products table (SKU-01000, Monitor arm, 9 cols, Enter Edit) rather than a query result. No viewer is open. Ctrl+W returns to Query 1, and Ctrl+Q exits 0.
cases.entry_path: launch tablepro --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120x40; click Development; click Connect; Ctrl+O; type products; Enter
cases.return_path: public › products table tab; Ctrl+W returns to Query 1; Ctrl+Q exits 0

cases.disposition_reason: Ctrl+O opens public › products. Two Rights land on the name cell and y copies Monitor arm (Copied 11 characters). Five more Rights land on attributes of row 0, whose raw text is {"color": "white", "weight_kg": 21.1}. Enter opens Dialog::facts titled attributes, with that cell pretty-printed ("color":"white", and "weight_kg":21.1) and a single Close button. The neighbor row's pretty tokens are absent. Dialog::facts paints the body as lines and has no selection widget and no copy command, so y while the dialog is open leaves the previous copy status in place. The open viewer is captured at 120×40, then after resize to 80×24, and the terminal returns to 120×40 before Close. Esc dismisses it: the pretty tokens and Close are gone, and the focus gutter is back on the same row, which still shows the white 21.1 cell. y then copies that cell's raw JSON (Copied 37 characters · {"color": "white", "weight_kg": 21.1}), not the name and not the neighbor row. Ctrl+Q exits 0.
cases.action_sequence: Open a viewer, select text, copy, and close.
cases.expected_results: The copy payload is the viewer text. Close returns focus to the cell.
cases.forbidden_effects: Close leaves the viewer title visible.
